comment: Read at commit debdfae, 'bump version to 2.1.0', whose res/LameJuis.svg is byte-identical to the installed panel; later commits keep the version at 2.1.0 while the repository moves off Rack entirely. The manual says the randomizers offer levels 0 to 3; LameJuisModel.cpp loops level < 3, so the submenus print Level 0, Level 1 and Level 2. The manual also says the video tutorial predates a panel transpose, so rows in the video are columns on this panel. The maker's tooltips call the six logic columns 'Step 1' to 'Step 6' while the panel prints S1 to S6, and call the co-mute positions 'Co-Muted' and 'On' where the panel gives no position names. Every parameter, input and output has a widget, so all 72 controls are reachable. The interval CV is coloured pitch because it is added in octaves to a pitch and the maker documents feeding a microtonal quantizer into it; the pitch select CV is coloured cv because its 0V to 5V span is an index into a sorted list rather than a pitch.
